description:
Machined for unyielding stability in high-buffet slipstreams, the Accessory from Universal Moto provides dependable hardware security and equipment mounting. Built with Marine-Grade 316 Stainless Steel & CNC Anodized Aluminum (Salt-Spray Resistant), it boasts an installation rating of 2.0 / 10 (Chin-mount curved adhesive contour bracket with anti-vibration damping).

The Accessory delivers robust utility and rock-solid mechanical reliability from Universal Moto, giving riders an uncompromising platform for telemetry, camera capture, or secure helmet stowage.
